response.rationale: These are two different concepts. A is the Hive, the beehive itself. HarvestRepository refers to it only by an identifier ("findByHive(hiveId: string): HarvestRecord[] {"), which links harvest records to a hive. B is the Hive Scale, a weighing device that ScaleService manages as its own entity ("): ScaleRecord {"). The graph backs this up. ScaleService calls ScaleRepository.findBySerial and WeightReadingRepository.findBySerialBetween, so scales are looked up by serial number and have weight readings of their own. It looks up hives through a different repository (HiveRepository.findById). A scale is linked to a hive, but it is a separate real-world thing, not another name for the hive.
